_comment: FOUR SHARDS TO A BLOCK, the same trade every other shard in this world makes (#276).
Sky stone is meteoric rock, and a meteorite is buried in the compacted depths, crushed into
the waste like everything else down there. Slag Rubble is where its pieces turn up.
Demand is bounded and front-loaded: 16 shards per Controller block and 16 per 256k cell
component - four shards to a block, then 1:1 smelting to smooth and 1:1 inscribing to dust -
so 50 to 150 shards for an entire playthrough, almost all spent once. Nothing in AE2 burns sky
stone as a running cost, which is why the drop can be the rarest thing in its stream.
TEMPORARY, and guarded. This is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship
data on 26.1.2; it leaves with the press pool - Flatts3000/trashlands#46.
The neoforge:mod_loaded guard is load-bearing rather than tidy. Strip it and this file does not
merely fail to apply, it fails to PARSE on its own result id - measured on the Simple Magnets
overrides in #271 - and one bad recipe file leaves a single ERROR line in an otherwise green run.
